content:
Use Seedance 2.5 with IMAGE LOCKS to pin key elements (e.g., Image 1 = cursor, Image 2 = city/style, Image 3 = Earth+meteor) and instruct the model to interpolate everything else while maintaining the locked style.

To prevent cursor drift, explicitly prompt: “Strictly preserve exact arrow shape, proportions, colors and handcrafted clay texture; only ONE cursor exists; never duplicate, deform or transform it.”

Define cursor motion like a real mouse by specifying continuous sweeping curves (S-curves, wide arcs), smooth acceleration/deceleration, constant forward momentum, and prohibiting teleporting, sudden jumps, stiff robotic movement, or superhero flight.

Force a continuous chase-camera by prompting “camera continuously chases and follows it” and specifying multiple cinematic angles across the duration (e.g., 15 angles over 30 seconds) with fluid, connected movement.

Add an explicit click-feedback rule: CLICK → bright glowing outline tightly traces the selected object; HOLD → outline remains; DRAG → object follows cursor; RELEASE → outline disappears.

For scaling interactions, require a specific gesture: “cursor must CLICK-HOLD, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement; as it moves farther LEFT, the object progressively becomes smaller in real time; never shrink automatically on click.”

Maintain action continuity by prompting that interactions happen while moving (curve toward problem → interact while moving → release → continue) and avoid “arrive, stop, act, leave” beats.

Lock a claymation look by specifying “bright vibrant handcrafted claymation/plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, saturated colors, soft cinematic daylight.”

If you want SFX-only output, explicitly prompt “No dialogue. No music. Mouse clicks and interface pops + environment SFX only.”

es.content:
Usa Seedance 2.5 con IMAGE LOCKS para fijar elementos clave (p. ej., Imagen 1 = cursor, Imagen 2 = ciudad/estilo, Imagen 3 = Tierra+meteoro) e indicarle al modelo que interpole todo lo demás manteniendo el estilo bloqueado.

Para evitar que el cursor se desvíe, indica explícitamente: “Strictly preserve exact arrow shape, proportions, colors and handcrafted clay texture; only ONE cursor exists; never duplicate, deform or transform it.”

Define el movimiento del cursor como el de un ratón real especificando curvas continuas y amplias (curvas en S, arcos amplios), aceleración/desaceleración suaves, impulso constante hacia delante, y prohibiendo la teletransportación, los saltos bruscos, el movimiento robótico rígido o el vuelo de superhéroe.

Fuerza una cámara de persecución continua indicando “camera continuously chases and follows it” y especificando múltiples ángulos cinematográficos a lo largo de la duración (p. ej., 15 ángulos en 30 segundos) con movimiento fluido y conectado.

Añade una regla explícita de feedback al clic: CLICK → un contorno brillante y luminoso traza con precisión el objeto seleccionado; HOLD → el contorno permanece; DRAG → el objeto sigue al cursor; RELEASE → el contorno desaparece.

Para las interacciones de escala, exige un gesto específico: “cursor must CLICK-HOLD, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement; as it moves farther LEFT, the object progressively becomes smaller in real time; never shrink automatically on click.”

Mantén la continuidad de la acción indicando que las interacciones ocurren mientras se mueve (curve toward problem → interact while moving → release → continue) y evita los ritmos de “llegar, detenerse, actuar, irse”.

Bloquea un aspecto de claymation especificando “bright vibrant handcrafted claymation/plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, saturated colors, soft cinematic daylight.”

Si quieres una salida solo con SFX, indica explícitamente “No dialogue. No music. Mouse clicks and interface pops + environment SFX only.”

[Thread 2] Prompt: animación cinematográfica de claymation de 30 segundos, de ritmo rápido, con movimiento continuo y fluido. IMAGE LOCKS: Image 1 = CURSOR  . Strictly preserve its exact arrow shape, proportions, colors and handcrafted clay texture. Only ONE cursor exists. Never duplicate, deform or transform it. No face, eyes, arms or legs. Image 2 = CITY . Main environment and strict visual-style reference: vibrant colorful handcrafted plasticine city, playful miniature architecture, river, bridges, streets, vehicles, trees and bright daylight. Image 3 = EARTH + METEOR . Strict visual reference for Earth, outer space and the final meteor sequence. Everything not shown in these 3 references should be naturally imagined and interpolated by AI while maintaining the same colorful handcrafted claymation world. CURSOR MOVEMENT: The cursor moves exactly like a real computer cursor controlled by a smoothly rolling physical mouse, but translated into movement through a 3D world. Continuous long sweeping curves, elegant S-curves, wide arcs, smooth dives and climbs. It curves around buildings, sweeps across streets, skims above water and rises over rooftops. Smooth acceleration and deceleration, always maintaining forward momentum. No teleporting, no sudden position jumps, no stiff robotic movement, no bird-like or superhero flight. The cursor rarely stops. Camera continuously chases and follows it. CURSOR INTERACTION RULE: Whenever the cursor CLICKS an object, that exact object immediately becomes selected and a clean bright glowing outline tightly traces its entire silhouette. CLICK → glowing outline appears. HOLD → glowing outline remains. DRAG → selected object directly follows or changes according to cursor movement. RELEASE → glowing outline immediately disappears. For SCALING DOWN: cursor must CLICK-HOLD the object first, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement. As cursor moves farther LEFT, the selected object progressively becomes smaller in real time. The glowing outline shrinks together with it. Never shrink automatically on click. [0:00–0:06] CITY Start already mid-motion inside Image 2. Cursor smoothly sweeps through the colorful clay city, weaving between skyscrapers in long flowing S-curves. Camera races alongside and behind it, diving toward streets and rising above rooftops. Ahead, a huge billboard begins falling toward pedestrians. Cursor smoothly curves toward it → CLICK. Bright glowing outline instantly surrounds the billboard → HOLD → cursor continues moving and DRAGS the billboard sideways through the air → safely places it onto an empty rooftop → RELEASE. Outline disappears. Cursor immediately curves away without stopping. [0:06–0:12] BRIDGE Cursor dives toward the river, skims just above the water, then smoothly curves upward around the suspension bridge. Ahead, another bridge has a missing section while vehicles approach. Cursor sweeps across an intact bridge segment → CLICK. Glowing outline appears → COPY → PASTE. A duplicate bridge section appears selected with the same glowing outline. Cursor HOLD-DRAGS the new section smoothly through the air and places it precisely into the missing gap. SNAP! Bridge reconnects. RELEASE → outline disappears. Vehicles continue safely. Cursor immediately sweeps beneath the bridge and accelerates toward the edge of the city. [0:12–0:18] FOREST The colorful city naturally transitions into green hills and a handcrafted clay forest in the same visual style. Cursor flows smoothly between treetops. Part of the forest ahead is burning. Cursor makes a wide upward curve toward a small clay cloud → CLICK. A bright glowing outline traces the cloud → HOLD → DRAG the cloud above the burning forest. Cursor enlarges the selected cloud. The glowing outline expands together with it. RELEASE → outline disappears. The enlarged cloud releases heavy rain. Fire fades behind while cursor is already smoothly racing toward the coastline. [0:18–0:23] OCEAN Cursor emerges over the ocean and sweeps extremely low across the water. Camera chases just above the surface. A giant clay wave rises ahead of a small ship. Cursor curves smoothly onto the wave → CLICK. A bright glowing outline immediately traces the entire wave. HOLD. Cursor now performs one long, smooth LEFTWARD DRAG across the screen. As cursor physically moves farther LEFT, the selected wave continuously shrinks in real time: GIANT WAVE → MEDIUM WAVE → SMALL WAVE → TINY HARMLESS RIPPLE. The glowing outline continuously shrinks together with the wave. Only after the wave becomes tiny does cursor RELEASE. The glowing outline disappears instantly. The ship continues safely while cursor flows past it and makes one huge smooth upward arc toward the sky. [0:23–0:27] EARTH + METEOR Continuous extreme-speed ascent: ocean → clouds → upper atmosphere → outer space. No teleportation. Make the entire ascent feel physically connected. Transition naturally into Image 3. Earth curves beneath the cursor. A huge fiery meteor is approaching the planet. Cursor performs one enormous smooth sweeping curve around Earth and accelerates toward the meteor. CLICK. A bright glowing outline immediately traces the meteor. HOLD. Cursor makes one powerful long SIDEWAYS DRAG away from Earth. The selected meteor physically follows the cursor while its fiery trail bends into the new trajectory. The meteor is pulled completely away from its collision course. RELEASE. Glowing outline disappears and the meteor continues safely into deep space. [0:27–0:30] WORLD SAVED Cursor maintains its momentum and smoothly curves around Earth. Camera rapidly pulls back into an extreme wide shot. The colorful handcrafted clay Earth is safe below. The meteor disappears harmlessly into deep space. Cursor gradually slows for the first time and remains above Earth. A small clean computer-style message appears: “✓ WORLD SAVED” Cursor smoothly moves onto the message. CLICK. Cut to black. CAMERA: 15 different cinematic angles across 30 seconds. Dynamic chase camera, close tracking, street-level pursuit, aerial city sweeps, river-level tracking, smooth orbiting movements, environmental fly-throughs and extreme-wide space shots. Camera movement should feel fluid and connected. Use fast cuts only when they enhance speed; never make the journey feel fragmented. MOTION PRIORITY: The cursor must feel like someone is continuously rolling and sweeping a real mouse across a mousepad. Rescue actions are integrated naturally into its movement. It should not arrive, completely stop, perform an action, then leave. Whenever possible: curve toward problem → interact while moving → release → smoothly continue along the same trajectory. VISUAL INTERACTION PRIORITY: Every click must have immediate visual feedback through the glowing selection outline. Only the currently selected object receives the outline. The outline follows the exact shape, position and scale of that object until RELEASE. STYLE: Bright vibrant handcrafted claymation, colorful plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, rounded forms, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, playful proportions, saturated colors and soft cinematic daylight. Preserve Image 2’s visual language across city

Définissez le mouvement du curseur comme une vraie souris en spécifiant des courbes de balayage continues (S-curves, wide arcs), une accélération/décélération fluide, une impulsion vers l’avant constante, et en interdisant la téléportation, les sauts brusques, les mouvements robotiques raides ou le vol de super-héros.

Forcez une caméra de poursuite continue en indiquant “camera continuously chases and follows it” et en précisant plusieurs angles cinématographiques sur toute la durée (par ex. 15 angles sur 30 secondes) avec un mouvement fluide et connecté.

Ajoutez une règle explicite de retour de clic : CLICK → bright glowing outline tightly traces the selected object; HOLD → outline remains; DRAG → object follows cursor; RELEASE → outline disappears.

Pour les interactions de mise à l’échelle, exigez un geste précis : “cursor must CLICK-HOLD, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement; as it moves farther LEFT, the object progressively becomes smaller in real time; never shrink automatically on click.”

Maintenez la continuité de l’action en indiquant que les interactions se produisent pendant le mouvement (curve toward problem → interact while moving → release → continue) et évitez les rythmes “arrive, stop, act, leave”.

Verrouillez un rendu claymation en spécifiant “bright vibrant handcrafted claymation/plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, saturated colors, soft cinematic daylight.”

Si vous voulez une sortie uniquement SFX, indiquez explicitement “No dialogue. No music. Mouse clicks and interface pops + environment SFX only.”

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 を IMAGE LOCKS と組み合わせて使い、重要な要素を固定します（例：Image 1 = カーソル、Image 2 = 都市/スタイル、Image 3 = 地球+隕石）。それ以外は、ロックされたスタイルを維持しながらモデルに補完させます。

カーソルのドリフトを防ぐには、次のように明示的にプロンプトします：  
“Strictly preserve exact arrow shape, proportions, colors and handcrafted clay texture; only ONE cursor exists; never duplicate, deform or transform it.”

カーソルの動きは、実際のマウスのように定義します。連続的に流れるカーブ（S字カーブ、広い弧）、滑らかな加速/減速、一定の前進モメンタムを指定し、テレポート、急なジャンプ、硬直したロボット的な動き、スーパーヒーローのような飛行は禁止します。

“camera continuously chases and follows it” とプロンプトし、さらに全体の尺にわたって複数の cinematic アングル（例：30秒で15アングル）を指定することで、連続的な追跡カメラを強制します。動きは流動的で、つながりのあるものにします。

クリック時のフィードバックルールを明示的に追加します：CLICK → 明るく発光するアウトラインが選択対象をぴったりなぞる；HOLD → アウトラインは維持される；DRAG → オブジェクトがカーソルに追従する；RELEASE → アウトラインが消える。

スケーリング操作では、特定のジェスチャーを要求します：  
“cursor must CLICK-HOLD, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement; as it moves farther LEFT, the object progressively becomes smaller in real time; never shrink automatically on click.”

アクションの連続性を保つため、操作は移動しながら起こるようにプロンプトします（問題に向かって曲がる → 移動しながらインタラクト → 離す → 続行）。また、“到着して止まる→行動する→離れる” というビートは避けます。

クレイメーションの見た目を固定するには、次のように指定します：  
“bright vibrant handcrafted claymation/plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, saturated colors, soft cinematic daylight.”

SFX のみの出力にしたい場合は、明示的に次のようにプロンプトします：  
“No dialogue. No music. Mouse clicks and interface pops + environment SFX only.”

Seedance 2.5를 IMAGE LOCKS와 함께 사용해 핵심 요소를 고정하세요(예: Image 1 = 커서, Image 2 = 도시/스타일, Image 3 = 지구+운석). 그리고 잠금된 스타일을 유지한 채 나머지 모든 요소는 모델이 보간하도록 지시합니다.

커서 드리프트를 방지하려면 다음과 같이 명시적으로 프롬프트하세요: “Strictly preserve exact arrow shape, proportions, colors and handcrafted clay texture; only ONE cursor exists; never duplicate, deform or transform it.”

커서의 움직임은 실제 마우스처럼 연속적인 스윕 곡선(S-curve, 넓은 호), 부드러운 가속/감속, 일정한 전진 모멘텀을 지정해 정의하고, 텔레포트, 갑작스러운 점프, 뻣뻣한 로봇 같은 움직임, 슈퍼히어로 비행은 금지하세요.

“camera continuously chases and follows it”라고 프롬프트하고, 전체 길이에 걸쳐 여러 시네마틱 앵글을 지정해 연속적인 추적 카메라를 강제하세요(예: 30초 동안 15개의 앵글). 움직임은 유려하고 연결되어 있어야 합니다.

명시적인 클릭 피드백 규칙을 추가하세요: CLICK → 밝게 빛나는 윤곽선이 선택된 오브젝트를 정확히 따라 감싼다; HOLD → 윤곽선이 유지된다; DRAG → 오브젝트가 커서를 따라 움직인다; RELEASE → 윤곽선이 사라진다.

스케일 조작의 경우, 특정 제스처를 요구하세요: “cursor must CLICK-HOLD, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement; as it moves farther LEFT, the object progressively becomes smaller in real time; never shrink automatically on click.”

행동의 연속성을 유지하려면 상호작용이 이동 중에 일어나도록 프롬프트하세요(문제 쪽으로 곡선 이동 → 이동 중 상호작용 → 해제 → 계속 진행) 그리고 “도착, 정지, 행동, 이탈” 식의 비트는 피하세요.

클레이메이션 룩을 고정하려면 다음을 명시하세요: “bright vibrant handcrafted claymation/plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, saturated colors, soft cinematic daylight.”

SFX만 출력하고 싶다면 다음을 명시적으로 프롬프트하세요: “No dialogue. No music. Mouse clicks and interface pops + environment SFX only.”

Use Seedance 2.5 com IMAGE LOCKS para fixar elementos-chave (por exemplo, Image 1 = cursor, Image 2 = city/style, Image 3 = Earth+meteor) e instruir o modelo a interpolar todo o resto enquanto mantém o estilo travado.

Para evitar o desvio do cursor, use um prompt explícito: “Strictly preserve exact arrow shape, proportions, colors and handcrafted clay texture; only ONE cursor exists; never duplicate, deform or transform it.”

Defina o movimento do cursor como o de um mouse real, especificando curvas contínuas e amplas (S-curves, wide arcs), aceleração/desaceleração suave, momentum constante para frente e proibindo teletransporte, saltos bruscos, movimento robótico rígido ou voo de super-herói.

Force uma câmera de perseguição contínua com o prompt “camera continuously chases and follows it” e especificando múltiplos ângulos cinematográficos ao longo da duração (por exemplo, 15 angles over 30 seconds) com movimento fluido e conectado.

Adicione uma regra explícita de feedback de clique: CLICK → bright glowing outline tightly traces the selected object; HOLD → outline remains; DRAG → object follows cursor; RELEASE → outline disappears.

Para interações de escala, exija um gesto específico: “cursor must CLICK-HOLD, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement; as it moves farther LEFT, the object progressively becomes smaller in real time; never shrink automatically on click.”

Mantenha a continuidade da ação com o prompt de que as interações acontecem enquanto o cursor se move (curve toward problem → interact while moving → release → continue) e evite batidas do tipo “arrive, stop, act, leave”.

Trave um visual de claymation especificando “bright vibrant handcrafted claymation/plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, saturated colors, soft cinematic daylight.”

Se quiser saída apenas com SFX, use explicitamente o prompt “No dialogue. No music. Mouse clicks and interface pops + environment SFX only.”

使用 Seedance 2.5 的 IMAGE LOCKS 来固定关键元素（例如：Image 1 = 光标，Image 2 = 城市/风格，Image 3 = 地球+流星），并指示模型在保持锁定风格的同时，对其余所有内容进行插值生成。

为防止光标漂移，请明确提示：“严格保留箭头的精确形状、比例、颜色和手工黏土质感；只存在一个光标；绝不重复、变形或转换它。”

通过指定连续的扫掠曲线（S 形曲线、宽弧线）、平滑的加速/减速、恒定的前进动量，并禁止传送、突然跳跃、僵硬的机械式移动或超级英雄式飞行，来定义光标运动，使其像真实鼠标一样移动。

通过提示“camera continuously chases and follows it”来强制使用连续追踪镜头，并在整个时长内指定多个 cinematic 角度（例如 30 秒内 15 个角度），让镜头运动流畅且彼此衔接。

添加明确的点击反馈规则：CLICK → 明亮发光轮廓紧贴所选对象；HOLD → 轮廓保持；DRAG → 对象跟随光标；RELEASE → 轮廓消失。

对于缩放交互，要求一个特定手势：“cursor must CLICK-HOLD, then physically DRAG LEFT in one smooth continuous movement; as it moves farther LEFT, the object progressively becomes smaller in real time; never shrink automatically on click.”

通过提示交互发生在移动过程中（curve toward problem → interact while moving → release → continue），并避免“到达、停下、操作、离开”这种节奏，来保持动作连续性。

通过指定“bright vibrant handcrafted claymation/plasticine, visible fingerprints, slightly imperfect handmade surfaces, miniature stop-motion diorama aesthetic, saturated colors, soft cinematic daylight”来锁定黏土动画风格。

如果你只想要 SFX 输出，请明确提示：“No dialogue. No music. Mouse clicks and interface pops + environment SFX only.”
